title: On the seafront, in the medieval quarter

photo.caption: [[Photo 1 — shop front with its sign, still to be taken: the counter stands in for now]]

address: Lungomare Giovanni Caboto [[CIVICO]], 04024 Gaeta (LT), Italy — corner of Salita Porta di Terra, opposite the naval base.

modes.title: By car
modes.text: Parking along Lungomare Caboto [[parking notes]]. From Rome: A1 motorway, exit Cassino, then SS 630 towards Formia and Gaeta, about 1 h 40; or the Pontina and Flacca coastal road. From Naples: A1, exit Caianello or Capua, then Formia, about 1 h 15.

modes.title: By train
modes.text: Formia-Gaeta station (Intercity and regional trains from Rome Termini in 1 h 10, from Naples in 50 minutes), then the Cotral bus to Gaeta (stop [[STOP]]) or a taxi, 10 km.

modes.title: On foot
modes.text: From the Montagna Spaccata sanctuary and Serapo beach, [[minutes]] along the sea; from the castle and the cathedral, five minutes downhill.

modes.title: By boat
modes.text: From Base Nautica Flavio Gioia and the marina, ten minutes on foot along the seafront.
